title: Novorizontino vs São Bernardo: Clash that could shake up the Série B standings
seoTitle: Novorizontino vs São Bernardo: Série B Clash Preview
subtitle: Match scheduled for September 25 could send Novorizontino to the provisional top and bring São Bernardo closer to the playoffs
excerpt: Novorizontino and São Bernardo face each other this Friday, the 25th, at 7:30 PM, at the Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi Stadium, for the 30th round of Série B.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Novorizontino and São Bernardo face each other this Friday, the 25th, at 7:30 PM, at the Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi Stadium, for the 30th round of the Brazilian Championship Série B. The result could put Novorizontino at the provisional top of the competition and bring São Bernardo closer to the playoff qualification zone.

Novorizontino seeks to consolidate leadership position

With 50 points, Novorizontino occupies third place in the standings and has the opportunity to take the top spot if they win the duel. The team, managed by Enderson Moreira, is coming off a 2-1 defeat to Ceará, following a seven-game unbeaten streak. Among the highlights, Robson stands out as the second-highest scorer in Série B with 15 goals, while Rômulo leads the assist ranking with nine.

São Bernardo tries to climb in the promotion race

Positioned in 12th place with 41 points, São Bernardo wants to get closer to the G6, currently opened by Criciúma, which has 47 points. In the previous round, the club beat Atlético-GO 1-0, with a goal by Felipe Garcia. Dudu Miraíma is pointed out as the team's main chance creator.

Importance of the match for the standings

For Novorizontino, a victory represents the chance to provisionally take the lead of Série B, reinforcing the title race. For São Bernardo, the three points are crucial to reduce the distance to the clubs that have already secured a spot in the promotion playoffs.

Venue, time, and broadcasting

The clash takes place at the Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi Stadium, in Novo Horizonte (SP), with kickoff scheduled for 7:30 PM (Brasília time). The match will be followed in real time by fans, according to information released by media outlets.

Prospects for the 30th round

The 30th round of Série B also brings other decisive clashes, such as the duel between Vila Nova-GO and Londrina, in addition to matches that can influence the fight against relegation. The schedule runs until the end of the week, with games set for Saturday, Sunday, and Monday, keeping the tension high in the competition.

With information from Estadão, UOL.
